messages:
Yara: short post-all-hands thread about runtime roadmap items (perf, batching, kernel selector). dropping questions so we have a single place to track.

Ben: thanks  first: sequence bucketing for kernels  are we going to ship dynamic bucketing or a fixed set of seq-len tiers?

Tara: dynamic bucketing in the selector. runtime will map request seq_len -> nearest bucket at runtime, with a fallback to full-range kernel for rare tails. we cache mappings in the node agent and refresh every 10m.

Omar: important for customers: does that change observed latency for mid-tail sequences? any visible jitter?

Tara: small jitter on first-hit as mapping warms. median unchanged; p95 improves in many workloads because we avoid one-size-fits-all kernels. we'll monitor p50/p95/p99 after rollout.

Ben: batching nuance: can autopilot be biased toward smaller batches for chatty routes? we don't want to add user-visible latency.

Yara: yes  autopilot has a latency-first mode for chat routes that reduces max_batch_delay and prefers smaller batches. default stays balanced. route flag "batching_profile": "latency" available for opt-in.

Omar: cache eviction  any changes to prefix eviction or scan behavior? I saw some customer reports about long-tail prefixes filling KV.

Tara: adding an eviction heuristic: least-recently-used weighted by prefix length and hit-rate. plus a soft quota per-tenant to avoid noisy neighbors. will be opt-in first.

Ben: telemetry ask  can SRE see per-route kernel decision rates, sequence-bucket distribution, and batch-size percentiles?

Yara: yes  plan includes those three metrics plus a new "batch_drop_rate" metric when requests exceed max_batch_size. we'll add a console card for quick inspection.

SRE-Bot: action item created: add dashboard panels for kernel_decisions, seq_bucket_hist, batch_size_p50_p90_p99, batch_drop_rate. (ticket #INF-4921)

Omar: can we get a short canary snippet so SRE can wire alerts and an automated abort?

Tara: snippet below (pasteable):

```
canary:
  phases:
    - pct: 3
      hold: 6h
    - pct: 15
      hold: 12h
    - pct: 60
      hold: 24h
signals:
  latency:
    p95_multiplier: 1.18
  errors:
    multiplier: 2.5
  batching:
    batch_drop_rate_threshold: 0.03
  mem:
    gpu_mem_headroom_drop: 0.1
```

Ben: great. will add monitors and an automatic rollback playbook tied to those signals.

Yara: customer comms: one-liner for release notes? keep it non-technical.

Omar: suggested: "Improved runtime: smarter kernel selection and adaptive batching to reduce cost and tail latency; opt-in route controls available."

Tara: I'll own the deep-dive doc and the migration notes. first draft by Fri EOD.

Yara: thanks all  I'll post a summary to the release thread and link Tara's doc when ready. ping here for any post-rollout anomalies and paste screenshots.
